quotes.text: When consuming a new NSS entry point, check mailnews/nss-extra.symbols and the NSS version available in the paired Gecko revision. NSS_CMSSignerInfo_Destroy and HASH_GetHashOidTagByHashType_Util required separate exports, including a bustage followup. Bug1895370 coordinated the NSS3.101 release first. A source call can be correct while build/link availability is incomplete. No local linking was performed by this study.

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.
